project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend with Python FastAPI backend (BFF pattern)
test_framework: vitest with @testing-library/react for unit tests, playwright for e2e (not run in CI)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx vitest run (all 25+ tests must pass). 2. Run npx tsc --noEmit (no type errors). 3. Run npx vite build (production build succeeds).
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/TradutorSohaiClaude && npm install (already done). Backend: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - can install packages. No running backend server needed for unit tests. Backend tests use pytest with httpx. vitest uses jsdom environment.
contribution_requirements: All 25 existing tests must pass. Build must pass (tsc --noEmit && vite build). Backend backward-compatible. Follow existing provider patterns. BYOK header pattern: X-Byok-<Provider>. Next version will be v0.2.0-alpha.
key_patterns: Backend providers: each is a module in backend/app/providers/ with process_manga_page() for OCR and translate_bubbles() for translation. Pipeline orchestrator in backend/app/services/pipeline.py uses plan_pipeline() to route. Frontend: EngineId type in types.ts, BYOK keys in store/useAuthStore.ts, engine selection in store/useTranslatorStore.ts, API client in services/api/client.ts with X-Byok-* headers. Settings modals in features/settings/. Engine dropdowns in App.tsx sidebar.
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx, types.ts, package.json. /components: MangaViewer, ViewerToolbar, etc. /features/settings: settings modals. /features/translator: pipeline logic. /services/api: client.ts + pipelineApi.ts. /store: zustand stores. /backend/app: FastAPI app with /providers, /routers, /schemas, /services. /tests/unit: vitest tests.
